description: This file contains unit tests for the IniFileReader class, verifying token splitting, quoted token parsing, and reading meta information from INI files.

classes.name: IniFileReaderTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing IniFileReader functionality, including token parsing and meta data extraction from INI files.

methods.name: testSplit
methods.description: Tests the splitting of tokens from a string, including simple values and quoted strings.

methods.name: testQuotedTokens
methods.description: Tests handling of a quoted token with spaces.

methods.name: testRealLine
methods.description: Tests parsing of a typical INI line with multiple tokens.

methods.name: testTotalPagesSize
methods.description: Tests reading of overall size, signature, page size, and read commands from a raw INI content string.
